Glossary

The words used in Tsugumi's documents and screens. See each row's link for details.

Assembling processing

TermMeaning
WorkflowA graph of Cards connected by wires. The same thing a person draws, the Agent edits and the runtime executes (Rationale)
CardA unit of processing, with input and output ports and settings (Cards and Workflows)
Code CardA Card whose environment is defined in default.nix and whose processing is in src/ (C++ / Python / bash / R / Julia; Your first Card)
Built-in CardA Card without code: start (trigger), input value (input), fork, branch, merge and logger
DraftAn unimplemented Card with only a name and content. Wire Drafts up to draw a plan (their ports follow the wires) and have the Agent implement them
Card in Card (child Workflow)A Card with a Workflow inside. From outside it looks like one Card; open it to go inside
DefinitionThe folder definitions/<id>/ that is a Card's substance. One per Card
PortA Card's input or output. Output types are written in _outputs.fbs; input types are derived from the connected outputs
all / anyHow inputs are awaited. all takes one value from each once all required inputs have arrived; any consumes them in order of arrival (Execution semantics)
maxRunsThe most times a Card can be called in one Run. Keeps loops finite

Running and recording

TermMeaning
RunOne execution of a Workflow. Records the version (commit) at its start
InvocationOne execution of a Card within a Run. In a loop, the same Card is invoked many times
StageA step within an invocation: SDK preparation, Nix evaluation, build, run, output validation, saving (Stages)
skippedDownstream of a branch that was not taken. Not a failure
blockedA Card that cannot run because it depends on a Draft or a failed upstream Card. Comes with a reason
interruptedA run that was in progress when the process ended abnormally or restarted
Partial run (single run)Running only the chosen Cards, or "from here". Uses saved inputs (Rerunning from the middle)
Saved inputsThe full set of inputs of the latest invocation, used by partial runs. Saved separately from recordIO
recordIOA setting that keeps the input and output values of every invocation of a Card in the history (off by default)
retainArtifactA setting that keeps a Card's artifacts
ArtifactA file or folder a Card output
DisplayThe result a Card shows on screen: text, a table, an image, a chart and so on (Visualisation)
VersionA commit of the project's git. A named version is an annotated tag (Versions)

The runtime

TermMeaning
tsugumid (the core)A process, one per project, that handles the document, the scheduler, Nix evaluation and history
RPCThe contract by which the UI, the Web and the Agent talk to tsugumid (Protocol.md)
op_idThe ID of a request that changes something. A resend with the same ID is applied only once
revThe document's revision. A save is based on it, and a save based on an old one is refused as a conflict
Shared VMThe one Linux VM that the Mac app and the Mac's tsugumi command share. Only one of them can use it at a time (vm.lock; Security and isolation)
tsugumi-vmdThe managing process inside the VM. Starts each project's tsugumid with its own uid, namespaces and cgroup
WorkerThe process that runs a Card's code. Can stay resident across runs (Resident workers)
bubblewrap / SeatbeltHow Cards are isolated: bubblewrap inside the VM and on Linux, Seatbelt in a Web UI run directly on a Mac from the repository
pkgsPathThe nixpkgs that Cards use, pinned (tsugumi.json)

Agent

TermMeaning
AgentA chat connected to a model that makes and runs Cards with tools derived from the RPC (the Agent in Features)
HelperA child Agent the Agent uses to split up independent work
The thrush (Tsugumi)The bird of the chat and the guide. Flies around the screen to explain
Approval (approval_required)Asking the user to confirm when an Agent's save widens a Card's permissions (The Agent's permission boundary)
SkillA bundle of instructions called with $
